keyMode.manual.title: Ask me every time
keyMode.manual.summary: The server never keeps your key. You enter it for each sync.
keyMode.manual.risk: No automatic sync. Nobody with access to the server or its backups can read your bank PINs. The key is dropped when the sync ends, after any TAN wait.
keyMode.memory.title: Keep in server memory
keyMode.memory.summary: You unlock once; the key stays in the server's memory.
keyMode.memory.risk: Automatic sync runs while unlocked. The key is forgotten when you lock it, when the server restarts or when a new version is deployed, and syncs pause until you unlock again. Someone who controls the running server could read the key from memory.
keyMode.stored.title: Store on the server
keyMode.stored.summary: The key is kept encrypted with the server's own key.
keyMode.stored.risk: Automatic sync always runs, also after restarts. Whoever controls the server, or has the backups together with the server key, can decrypt your bank PINs.
